image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画唐「香积寺」（收复长安），时间757 年，唐肃宗至德二载。地点与格局：香积寺、长安。人物：郭子仪（唐副元帅）、李嗣业（唐将）、安守忠（燕将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "香积寺" (收复长安) in the 唐 chapter, 757 年. Place and layout: Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an. Figures: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "香积寺" (收复长安) in the 唐 chapter, 757 年. Place and layout: Xiangji Temple, west of Chang'an. Figures: Guo Ziyi, Li Siye, An Shouzhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 河阳之战
scenes.subtitle: 李光弼
scenes.narrative: 乾元二年，史思明在相州打败九节度的联军之后南下。李光弼放弃洛阳，把军队收缩到河阳的三城，背靠黄河，用城北、中潬和南城互相支援。史思明攻城不利，自己在河清被射伤。河阳没有把叛军消灭，但把东都空出来换了一条守得住的河防线。本场画黄河里的中潬城和两岸的栅栏，不画洛阳宫殿里的宴饮。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「河阳之战」（李光弼），时间759 年，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：河阳、中潬。人物：李光弼（唐太尉）、史思明（燕帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "河阳之战" (李光弼) in the 唐 chapter, 759 年. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort. Figures: Li Guangbi, Shi Siming. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画唐「河阳之战」（李光弼），时间759 年，唐肃宗乾元二年。地点与格局：河阳、中潬。人物：李光弼（唐太尉）、史思明（燕帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "河阳之战" (李光弼) in the 唐 chapter, 759 年. Place and layout: Heyang and the mid-river fort. Figures: Li Guangbi, Shi Siming. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：唐「河阳之战」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "河阳之战" in 唐.

scenes.title: 柏乡之战
scenes.subtitle: 晋破后梁

when.era: 后梁开平五年 · 乾化元年

scenes.narrative: 后梁王景仁率兵北上，在柏乡和高邑之间与晋王李存勖对峙。周德威劝李存勖先退到高邑，让梁军离开营栅、人马饥渴，再反击。梁军果然被引出，晋军用骑兵把他们切碎。柏乡之战让河朔的天平从梁转到晋，也是李存勖从父亲的三支箭故事走进真正会战的一仗。本场画冬天的原野和梁军丢下的营栅。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画五代十国「柏乡之战」（晋破后梁），时间911 年，后梁开平五年 · 乾化元年。地点与格局：柏乡、高邑。人物：李存勖（晋王）、周德威（晋将）、王景仁（后梁将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "柏乡之战" (晋破后梁) in the 五代十国 chapter, 911 年. Place and layout: Baixiang. Figures: Li Cunxu, Zhou Dewei, Wang Jingren. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 高梁河
scenes.subtitle: 宋辽首次大战

when.era: 宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年

scenes.narrative: 太平兴国四年，宋太宗灭北汉后不停脚，直接去攻辽南京。城下宋军已经疲敝。辽将耶律沙在高梁河与宋军接触，耶律休哥和耶律斜轸随后赶到，宋师大溃，太宗连夜退走，与主力失散。《宋史》对这场败写得含糊，《辽史·景宗纪》把追击写得更明白。本场以辽史能对上的结果为准：南京城北的河岸，宋军向南溃退。

sources.title: 辽史
sources.notes: 乾亨元年高梁河破宋师

sources.title: 宋史
sources.notes: 太平兴国四年北伐幽州，师还

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战），时间979 年，宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年。地点与格局：高梁河、南京。人物：宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "高梁河" (宋辽首次大战) in the 北宋 chapter, 979 年. Place and layout: Gaoliang River, near Yanjing. Figures: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "高梁河" in 北宋.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「高梁河」（宋辽首次大战），时间979 年，宋太平兴国四年 · 辽乾亨元年。地点与格局：高梁河、南京。人物：宋太宗（宋帝）、耶律休哥（辽将）、耶律沙（辽将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "高梁河" (宋辽首次大战) in the 北宋 chapter, 979 年. Place and layout: Gaoliang River, near Yanjing. Figures: Emperor Taizong of Song, Yelü Xiuge, Yelü Sha. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 定川寨
scenes.subtitle: 庆历西夏

when.era: 宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年

scenes.narrative: 好水川的第二年，李元昊再次入宋边。宋将葛怀敏在定川寨被夏军包围，夜里溃围，本人死在乱军里。夏军进到渭州，在城下大掠后退走。范仲淹、韩琦在西北的防守并没有因为一次败仗就撤掉，但定川说明宋军出寨会战仍然容易被引进伏地。本场和好水川分开：换了主将、换了寨名，仍是同一条边境上的第二次大败。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画北宋「定川寨」（庆历西夏），时间1042 年，宋庆历二年 · 夏天授礼法延祚五年。地点与格局：定川寨、渭州。人物：李元昊（夏国主）、葛怀敏（宋将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "定川寨" (庆历西夏) in the 北宋 chapter, 1042 年. Place and layout: Dingchuan Fort. Figures: Li Yuanhao, Ge Huaimin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 绍兴十年金军毁约南下。刘锜刚到顺昌，就地筑羊马垣，把船只沉了表示不走。完颜宗弼的重甲骑兵攻城，刘锜在城下设伏，又趁大雨后的暑热出击。金军退走，顺昌保住。这是岳飞北伐同一年里、由另一支军队打的守城战，不能并进朱仙镇的故事里。本场画顺昌的矮墙、城河和城外停住的金军旗帜。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「顺昌之战」（刘锜），时间1140 年，宋绍兴十年 · 金天眷三年。地点与格局：顺昌。人物：刘锜（宋将）、完颜宗弼（金都元帅）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "顺昌之战" (刘锜) in the 南宋 chapter, 1140 年. Place and layout: Shunchang. Figures: Liu Qi, Wanyan Zongbi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：南宋「顺昌之战」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "顺昌之战" in 南宋.

scenes.title: 陈家岛
scenes.subtitle: 李宝焚舟

when.era: 宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年

scenes.narrative: 海陵王南侵时，金朝水军从密州一带南下。李宝率宋朝舟师北上，在胶西陈家岛附近发现金船还挂着帆、士兵多不习水。宋军趁风放火，金舟大半被烧，赴海的人很多。这一仗和虞允文的采石几乎同时，一个在黄海之滨，一个在长江。本场只取陈家岛的船队和火，不把采石的陆军混进来，也不画近代舰船。

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「陈家岛」（李宝焚舟），时间1161 年，宋绍兴三十一年 · 金大定元年。地点与格局：陈家岛、胶西。人物：李宝（宋浙西路马步军副总管）、完颜郑家（金水军统领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "陈家岛" (李宝焚舟) in the 南宋 chapter, 1161 年. Place and layout: Chenjia Island. Figures: Li Bao, Wanyan Zhengjia. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "陈家岛" in 南宋.

scenes.title: 符离之战
scenes.subtitle: 隆兴北伐

when.era: 宋隆兴元年 · 金大定三年

scenes.narrative: 孝宗起用张浚，想在绍兴和议之后再打一次。李显忠收复宿州，邵宏渊却与他不和，金军反击时宋军在符离崩溃，军资几乎丢光。张浚的北伐就此停住，朝廷重新走向和议。符离的意义是负的：它说明南宋不是没有北伐的意愿，而是前线两将不协、粮械跟不上时，一次胜利会马上变成溃退。本场画符离路上丢弃的旗帜和向南的溃兵剪影。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画南宋「符离之战」（隆兴北伐），时间1163 年，宋隆兴元年 · 金大定三年。地点与格局：符离、宿州。人物：张浚（宋枢密使）、李显忠（宋将）、邵宏渊（宋将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "符离之战" (隆兴北伐) in the 南宋 chapter, 1163 年. Place and layout: Fuli. Figures: Zhang Jun, Li Xianzhong, Shao Hongyuan. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 野狐岭
scenes.subtitle: 蒙古破金

when.era: 金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年

scenes.narrative: 成吉思汗在大安三年大举攻金。金军在野狐岭、会河川设防，成吉思汗派木华黎率敢死之士冲击，金军大败，死者被史书写成蔽野。野狐岭是从草原进入华北平原的山口，这一仗之后金朝的北边门户等于被打开，中都开始暴露。西夏、南宋的年号此时并存，本场的纪年以金朝大安三年为准，因为防守的一方是金。

sources.title: 元史
sources.notes: 大安三年破金军于野狐岭

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「野狐岭」（蒙古破金），时间1211 年，金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年。地点与格局：野狐岭、会河川。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古大汗）、木华黎（蒙古将）、独吉思忠（金将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "野狐岭" (蒙古破金) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1211 年. Place and layout: Yehuling Pass. Figures: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「野狐岭」（蒙古破金），时间1211 年，金大安三年 · 宋嘉定四年。地点与格局：野狐岭、会河川。人物：成吉思汗（蒙古大汗）、木华黎（蒙古将）、独吉思忠（金将）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频让墨线沿水系或路线缓慢延伸，雾在山层间移动，城郭与关隘保持不变形，镜头像沿地图缓缓走过。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "野狐岭" (蒙古破金) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1211 年. Place and layout: Yehuling Pass. Figures: Genghis Khan, Muqali, Duji Sizhong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 丁家洲
scenes.subtitle: 伯颜渡江

when.era: 元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年

scenes.narrative: 襄阳、樊城陷落后，伯颜沿汉水入江。贾似道被迫督师，在池州下游的丁家洲把舟师排开。元军炮击并冲阵，宋军没怎么接战就溃了，贾似道逃到扬州。长江上的这次崩溃比崖山早四年，它决定的是沿江州郡不再有统一的防线。本场画江面的船阵和岸上扔下的旗，不把崖山的末帝船队提前画出来。

sources.title: 元史

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画元「丁家洲」（伯颜渡江），时间1275 年，元至元十二年 · 宋德祐元年。地点与格局：丁家洲、池州。人物：伯颜（元丞相）、贾似道（宋右丞相）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "丁家洲" (伯颜渡江) in the 元 chapter, 1275 年. Place and layout: Dingjiazhou. Figures: Bayan, Jia Sidao. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.narrative: 建文二年，李景隆率号称百万的南军北上，与燕王朱棣在白沟河相遇。南军在数量上占优，燕军一度被压到绝境，朱棣几乎陷在阵里。风向一转，南军大火烧营，李景隆连夜逃回德州。这一仗不是金川门那场不战而降，而是靖难里少有的大规模野战。本场只取白沟河的夜火和两军旗帜，不把后来的“诛十族”写进同一画面。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「白沟河」（靖难前哨），时间1400 年，明建文二年。地点与格局：白沟河。人物：朱棣（燕王）、李景隆（大将军）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "白沟河" (靖难前哨) in the 明 chapter, 1400 年. Place and layout: Baigou River. Figures: Zhu Di, Li Jinglong. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "白沟河" (靖难前哨) in the 明 chapter, 1400 年. Place and layout: Baigou River. music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：明「白沟河」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "白沟河" in 明.

scenes.title: 平壤之战
scenes.subtitle: 李如松援朝
scenes.narrative: 万历朝鲜之役里，日军占领平壤。万历二十一年正月，李如松督明军攻城，用大炮轰开城门一带，日军退向汉城。明军入城后抢掠，李如松斩了自己的部下压住。这是明军在朝鲜打的一次真正的攻城，和后来碧蹄馆的受挫不是同一天。本场画冬日的平壤城墙和城门上的烟，画面里不出现近代枪械的特写，火器只作为城头的烟。

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝），时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画明「平壤之战」（李如松援朝），时间1593 年，明万历二十一年。地点与格局：平壤。人物：李如松（明提督）、小西行长（日军将领）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "平壤之战" (李如松援朝) in the 明 chapter, 1593 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang. Figures: Li Rusong, Konishi Yukinaga. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "平壤之战" (李如松援朝) in the 明 chapter, 1593 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang. Image-to-video lets an ink line creep along the rivers or the route, mist drifting between mountain layers, cities and passes holding their shape, the camera walking slowly along the map. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 松锦之战
scenes.subtitle: 洪承畴

when.era: 明崇祯十三年至十五年
when.notes: start 取围城之始；城破与洪承畴降在崇祯十五年。

scenes.narrative: 清军围锦州，明廷派洪承畴出山海关救援。他起初主守，朝里催促进战，明军集结在松山。皇太极切断粮道之后，明军夜溃，洪承畴被困在松山，次年城破被俘，祖大寿也开锦州出降。松锦之后，明朝在关外只剩下宁远等少数孤城。本场和袁崇焕的宁远守城分开：那是天启的胜仗，这是崇祯的大败。画面取长围、粮道和关外的雪。

sources.title: 明史
sources.notes: 崇祯十五年松山陷，洪承畴降

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴），时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "松锦之战" (洪承畴) in the 明 chapter, 1640—1642 年. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou. Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画明「松锦之战」（洪承畴），时间1640—1642 年，明崇祯十三年至十五年。地点与格局：松山、锦州。人物：洪承畴（明蓟辽总督）、皇太极（清太宗）、祖大寿（明总兵）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "松锦之战" (洪承畴) in the 明 chapter, 1640—1642 年. Place and layout: Songshan and Jinzhou. Figures: Hong Chengchou, Hong Taiji, Zu Dashou. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 雅克萨
scenes.subtitle: 两次围城

when.era: 清康熙二十四年至二十五年
when.notes: 康熙二十四年取城，二十五年俄军复至，再次围城后议和。

scenes.narrative: 俄罗斯人在雅克萨筑城，清廷先致书，不成，康熙二十四年派彭春、萨布素等水陆并进，攻下城后平毁，允许俄人退走。第二年俄军又回来筑城，清军再围。双方最后在尼布楚谈界。本场只写这两次围城，不把康熙二十八年的条约文本放进画面——划界已有专场可走。画面是黑龙江上的木城、船只和城外的营垒。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙二十四年攻雅克萨，二十五年复围

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「雅克萨」（两次围城），时间1685—1686 年，清康熙二十四年至二十五年。地点与格局：雅克萨、黑龙江。人物：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "雅克萨" (两次围城) in the 清 chapter, 1685—1686 年. Place and layout: Albazin on the Amur. Figures: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。地理主线。画成水墨地图的一角：水系、关隘、城址、边墙与一条行军或漕运路线，三四层平涂的山与河；人物只是路线上的小剪影。朱红不超过一成。这一帧画清「雅克萨」（两次围城），时间1685—1686 年，清康熙二十四年至二十五年。地点与格局：雅克萨、黑龙江。人物：萨布素（清黑龙江将军）、彭春（清都统）、托尔布津（俄军头目）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Geography is the main line, painted as a corner of an ink map: river systems, passes, cities, frontier walls and one campaign or canal route, mountains and water in three or four flat grey layers. Figures are small silhouettes on the route. Vermilion under ten percent. This still is "雅克萨" (两次围城) in the 清 chapter, 1685—1686 年. Place and layout: Albazin on the Amur. Figures: Sabsu, Pengcun, Afanasy Tolbuzin. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 昭莫多
scenes.subtitle: 费扬古
scenes.narrative: 康熙亲征噶尔丹，自己率中路出草原，西路费扬古拦在昭莫多。噶尔丹的军队从土拉河来，费扬古先据山，用下马步战拖住，再以骑兵袭其后营。噶尔丹丢掉辎重逃走，阿奴等人战死。昭莫多是乌兰布通之后真正把噶尔丹从漠北打散的一仗。本场画山梁上的下马军阵和河湾，康熙的御营放在远处，不画近代地图的经纬线。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 康熙三十五年昭莫多之战

video.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「昭莫多」（费扬古），时间1696 年，清康熙三十五年。地点与格局：昭莫多、土拉河。人物：费扬古（清抚远大将军）、噶尔丹（准噶尔汗）、康熙帝（清帝）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。图生视频只拍战前的军阵、战鼓声里轻轻扯动的旌旗、尘雾缓移，或战后定住的一团泼墨与一面朱红战旗。生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。
video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "昭莫多" (费扬古) in the 清 chapter, 1696 年. Place and layout: Zuunmod and the Tuul. Figures: Fiyanggū, Galdan, Kangxi Emperor. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

scenes.title: 平壤陆战
scenes.subtitle: 左宝贵
scenes.narrative: 甲午年日本陆军进逼平壤。清军叶志超主退，总兵左宝贵坚持守北城，穿上朝服登城指挥，在玄武门中炮而死。叶志超随即弃城。这是黄海海战之外、陆地上决定朝鲜战局的一仗。《清史稿·左宝贵传》写了他的死，《德宗本纪》写了平壤溃。本场画平壤北城的城楼和一面还在的旗帜，不画近代步枪的特写，炮烟只作为城头的一团墨。

sources.title: 清史稿
sources.notes: 光绪二十年守平壤玄武门，中炮死

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画清「平壤陆战」（左宝贵），时间1894 年，清光绪二十年。地点与格局：平壤、玄武门。人物：左宝贵（清总兵）、叶志超（清总统）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "平壤陆战" (左宝贵) in the 清 chapter, 1894 年. Place and layout: Pyongyang, North Gate. Figures: Zuo Baogui, Ye Zhichao. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 更戍法
scenes.subtitle: 禁军轮驻

when.notes: 《宋史·兵志》说太祖立更戍法，没有系于某一天。

scenes.narrative: 宋太祖把精兵收到中央，让禁军定期换防，将领不固定带同一支兵，兵也不固定驻同一座城。《宋史·兵志》认为这是为了防止唐末藩镇的兵为将有。代价后来也很清楚：兵不识将，训练变差，一到对外战争就显出来。本场只画士卒出发换防的名册和空着的将旗，不把杯酒释兵权的宴会再演一遍。

sources.title: 宋史

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画北宋「更戍法」（禁军轮驻），时间约建隆年间，宋建隆中。地点与格局：汴京。人物：宋太祖（宋帝）、赵普（枢密使）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "更戍法" (禁军轮驻) in the 北宋 chapter, 约建隆年间. Place and layout: Bianjing. Figures: Emperor Taizu of Song, Zhao Pu. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

scenes.title: 绍兴和议
scenes.subtitle: 淮水为界

when.era: 宋绍兴十一年 · 金皇统元年

scenes.narrative: 绍兴十一年，宋金再定和议：宋称臣，岁贡银绢，两国以淮水中流、大散关为界，并割唐、邓。岳飞在这一年被杀，是和议的配套，已有“精忠”一场。本场只取边界和誓书：一张把淮河画成国界的地图，和朝堂上的岁币账。地理上的淮河另有专场可画水，这里画的是条约如何写成。

sources.title: 金史
sources.notes: 皇统元年宋称臣，画淮为界

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画南宋「绍兴和议」（淮水为界），时间1141 年，宋绍兴十一年 · 金皇统元年。地点与格局：临安、淮河。人物：秦桧（宰相）、宋高宗（宋帝）、完颜宗弼（金都元帅）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). Statecraft is the main line: a court hall, memorials, a seal, granaries, a canal or weir, and statutes hung in an orderly scroll-grid. Vermilion only for the seal, under ten percent. No army formations, no combat. This still is "绍兴和议" (淮水为界) in the 南宋 chapter, 1141 年. Place and layout: Lin'an and the Huai. Figures: Qin Hui, Emperor Gaozong, Wanyan Zongbi. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

music.zh: 配乐庄严，近于朝会：编钟与古琴，缓慢，五声音阶，没有歌词，不要战鼓喧哗。本场：南宋「绍兴和议」。
music.en: Music is solemn and courtly: bells and qin, slow, pentatonic, no lyrics, no battlefield drums. This cue: "绍兴和议" in 南宋.

scenes.title: 猛安谋克
scenes.subtitle: 女真的军政单位
scenes.narrative: 女真起兵之前，阿骨打就把部人编成猛安、谋克：猛安相当于千户，谋克相当于百户，平时狩猎耕种，战时出兵。《金史·太祖纪》和《兵志》都写了这套编制在宁江州之战前后被用来扩军。它既是军队也是户籍。本场和护步答冈的会战分开，只画营帐和户册。南下中原以后，猛安谋克迁到华北屯田，是后来的问题，不在这一年。

sources.title: 金史
sources.notes: 天庆四年起兵，以猛安谋克统军

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。治国主线。画面以朝堂、奏疏、印章、粮仓、渠堰与挂在墙上的典章为中心，布局整齐如卷轴格网；朱红只用于印章，不超过一成。不排军阵，不写厮杀。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「猛安谋克」（女真的军政单位），时间1114 年，辽天庆四年。地点与格局：宁江州。人物：完颜阿骨打（女真都勃极烈）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。

Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

image.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）。战场主线。画面以军阵、旌旗、壁垒、攻城器械与战尘为中心，队列呈斜向冲势；朱红只用于战旗与血雾，不超过一成。不画兵刃相接，只给列阵或战后定格。这一帧画辽 · 西夏 · 金「猛安谋克」（女真的军政单位），时间1114 年，辽天庆四年。地点与格局：宁江州。人物：完颜阿骨打（女真都勃极烈）。黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读。色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。侧视，地平线在下三分之一，三四层平涂灰阶，大面积留白。画面内不写字。
image.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "猛安谋克" (女真的军政单位) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1114 年. Place and layout: Ningjiang. Figures: Wanyan Aguda. rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance. strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame. Side view, horizon on the lower third, three or four flat grey layers, generous empty space. No text in the frame.

video.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified). War is the main line: massed troops, banners, ramparts, siege engines and battle dust, the ranks driving on a diagonal. Vermilion only for war flags and blood mist, under ten percent of the frame. No blades meeting — a formation, or a freeze after the battle. This still is "猛安谋克" (女真的军政单位) in the 辽 · 西夏 · 金 chapter, 1114 年. Place and layout: Ningjiang. Image-to-video shows only the army forming, banners tugging as if war drums were near, dust drifting slowly, or a frozen splash of ink and one vermilion war-flag after the fighting. Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

music.zh: 配乐以战争为线：战鼓由疏到密，号角拉长，低弦走五声音阶，没有歌词；高潮只一记重鼓，随即收住。本场：辽 · 西夏 · 金「猛安谋克」。
music.en: Music follows the war: drums thickening, a long horn, low pentatonic strings, no lyrics; one heavy drum-stroke at the climax, then stop. This cue: "猛安谋克" in 辽 · 西夏 · 金.
